assertions: Scope fallback result total reports precision correctly, not exact when remote page incomplete

assertions: Near query must be faithfully supported or return not_supported, no silent exact/relevance

cases.title: E Search Sort
assertions: Canonical/chronological sort must not silently use relevance

cases.title: E Search Cursor
assertions: Filtered/invalid raw hits do not skip cursor or cause nextOffset stalls

cases.title: All Count Two Words
assertions: Token count two occurrences in one segment must equal 2 or explicit exact_count_unavailable; never 1

cases.title: E Links Rpc Failure
assertions: Failed relationships RPC returns unavailable, not completed with empty links

cases.title: E Versions Rpc Failure
assertions: Failed version RPC returns unavailable, not completed with empty versions

cases.title: E Download Status Fail
assertions: RPC runtime not ready cannot mean zero installed packages/no updates

cases.title: E Nav Trim Only
assertions: Unknown Hebrew phrase is not declared valid canonicalRef simply from whitespace trim

cases.title: O Topics Stub
assertions: topics() empty stub must not be advertised as complete semantic topics support

cases.title: L Offline Search
assertions: Downloaded text alone does not imply working offline search

cases.title: E Search Not Ready
assertions: Host ready but searchReady=false => initializing/unavailable, never zero matches

cases.title: E Packages Not Ready
assertions: Catalog ready but packagesReady=false => package API unavailable

cases.title: L Offline Reader
assertions: Downloaded book section readable while disconnected; uninstalled work unavailable

assertions: maktabah://annotation and maktabah://history continue unchanged

cases.title: App Narrative Open
assertions: reader.open returns UI-queued or requires foreground until appropriate native/RN scene acknowledges

cases.title: App Intents Three
